_about: 4-28. The knight carries the yellow key and the port gives nothing that kills it where the key
can be reached (the fire agent does not burn a minion: minions.json _burnable_breakable_not_wired;
a shot through the flame stays a shot: G8). But a key opens its keyhole in any carrier's hands
(Keys::State::Tick), so the knight opens the door. Off the spawn's left end, a few steps right, a
portal on the ramp at (270, 200) and one on the player; up the ramp. A portal high over the
keyhole at (440, 10), then one on the knight's walk at (140, 206): it drops past the keyhole and
the key is spent 24 px from it on tick ~924; the door goes on 1010. The knight walks down the
ramp at the player, so a portal behind it at (380, 172) and one on the player, and right to the
door. Won on tick 1094 (step 170). DEPENDS ON R1 NOT BEING BUILT: three taps lie inside the
original's 32 x 6 = 192 px of antiportal_1940 (452, 108; scale 6): (440, 10) at 98.7 px and
(380, 172) at 96.3 px, just outside the port's 16 x 6 = 96 (the second by 0.3 px), and the
self-tap (296.5, 192.9) at 177.2 px; and on G1 (knights never shoot). R1's step re-routes it.
